test: JBD exact module electrical safety audit
method: Official power/connector doc + board net inspection
acceptance: Pin/rail mapping signed off; no unknown rail energized

method: OEM EVK + oscilloscope/LA, verified command table
acceptance: Device ID/status and vendor test pattern pass; record actual resolution

method: Test vectors / photodiode or highspeed camera, per-eye CS
acceptance: Measured left-right update offset <=1 frame (16.7ms at 60Hz), no unacceptable flicker; provisional target

method: Collimated target + rigid dual cameras + eye pupils and cross pattern
acceptance: <=1 mrad≈3.44 arcmin after calibration, provisional project target

method: Controlled twist load; repeat collimated dual eye measure
acceptance: Measure arcmin/(N mm); performance budget to be set after supplier tolerance signoff

method: Hinge opening rig with 4-wire continuity monitoring
acceptance: >=10k cycles no open; resist change <=10% is provisional screening, not lifetime qualification
evidence: cycle log, pre/post R, failure photos

method: Real prototype 1A controlled pulse or safe rated lower value
acceptance: Target <=0.15V at specified pulse length; log fault/transients; provisional

method: Thermal chamber + thermocouples/IR with emissivity calibration
acceptance: Project interim <=43C contact surface, actual standard test condition TBD; steady/transient distinguished

method: Calibrated scale, disassembled parts and assembled device
acceptance: Production target <=40.0g; design budget <=39.5g; no omissions
Approved branch: tool run exit 0 and issues triaged; no rule relaxation
evidence: tool versions, full logs, source commit

acceptance: All required CI jobs pass, behavior vectors and timing clean

method: Applicable official standards + certified lab plan
